equivalence_criteria.float32_vs_frozen_float64: the frozen numpy casts to float64 internally, so a float32 torch tensor cannot match it to 1e-6 absolute when |d2| ~ 11: float32 eps * 11 = 1.3e-6. The absolute gap measured is 1.2e-6 and the criterion is therefore stated RELATIVELY: <= 2 float32 ulp of max|d2|.

deviation_from_specification: the specification asked for float32 max|diff| <= 1e-6 against the frozen operators. That bound is not attainable for float32 inputs at |d2| ~ 11 and is a precision artefact, not an operator mismatch: in matched dtype the two implementations are BIT-IDENTICAL. Recorded rather than fudged.
